+#!/bin/bash
+
+rename_timestamped_pdf() {
+	local output_dir="$1"
+	local timestamped_pdf stable_pdf pdf_name stable_name
+
+	for timestamped_pdf in "$output_dir"/*.pdf; do
+		[[ -f "$timestamped_pdf" ]] || continue
+		pdf_name="${timestamped_pdf##*/}"
+		[[ "$pdf_name" =~ -[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}\.pdf$ ]] || continue
+
+		for stable_pdf in "$output_dir"/*.pdf; do
+			[[ -f "$stable_pdf" && "$stable_pdf" != "$timestamped_pdf" ]] || continue
+			stable_name="${stable_pdf##*/}"
+			if [[ ! "$stable_name" =~ -[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}\.pdf$ ]]; then
+				mv -f -- "$timestamped_pdf" "$stable_pdf"
+				return
+			fi
+		done
+	done
+}
+
+rename_timestamped_pdf experiment-results/1-Workloads/TPCC-SQL/Combined/
+rename_timestamped_pdf experiment-results/1-Workloads/Seats/Combined
+rename_timestamped_pdf experiment-results/1-Workloads/Smallbank/Combined
+rename_timestamped_pdf experiment-results/2-Microbenchmarks/1-Vary-Policy/RW-SQL-U
+rename_timestamped_pdf experiment-results/2-Microbenchmarks/1-Vary-Policy/RW-SQL-Z
+rename_timestamped_pdf experiment-results/2-Microbenchmarks/2-Gov-Txn
+rename_timestamped_pdf experiment-results/2-Microbenchmarks/3-Client-Failures/RW-SQL-U
+rename_timestamped_pdf experiment-results/2-Microbenchmarks/3-Client-Failures/RW-SQL-Z
+rename_timestamped_pdf experiment-results/2-Microbenchmarks/4-Lifting/
+rename_timestamped_pdf experiment-results/2-Microbenchmarks/5-Random-Policy/
